scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:json && npm run check:wxss && npm run check:consistency && npm run test:calc && npm run test:phase2 && npm run test:pages && npm run test:integrity && npm run test:pdf
scripts.check:syntax: find miniprogram cloudfunctions -name '*.js' -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -n 1 node --check
scripts.check:json: find miniprogram -name '*.json' -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -n 1 node -e "const fs=require('fs'); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8'));"
